limits: Automatic Cluster address selection, node pools, original-deadline redirect/refresh execution and resharding/failover remain subsequent work.
Real Cluster fixtures are owned Redis8.0.5 plaintext IPv4 in WSL. Managed RESP2/3/AUTO and a nopass ACL profile are real; complete real TLS/auth/trust interop remains open.
TLS write/cancel boundaries use local deterministic peers/custom fixture trust. They are not upstream-server TLS acceptance.
All ordinary P99 baseline comparisons fail noise qualification in this run. Their raw results remain unqualified, not production-tail evidence.
Performance is unpinned closed-loop local C-peer traffic with caller-observed queue latency. Heap figures include peer/mechanical work and are not isolated library/bridge costs.
Native Linux/upstream/fixed-arrival/mixed-load/CPU/RSS and >=72h four-library production gates remain open.

The baseline benchmark omits unavailable ASKING call/check branches via AK_BENCH_BASELINE. Both ordinary variants still use the same ECHO/worker profiles; the comparison includes this small selector-code difference.
